sources: Karak: Sidhar, Kirima, Elspeth hero sheet (Albi, 2022)

steps.text: Starting dungeon tile in the middle of the table
Shuffle the other tiles facedown within everyone's reach
Monster and treasure tokens in the bag
Add the Regent tiles (arenas, cursed chambers, rooms), monster tokens and heroes to the base components
Each player takes an inventory sheet with {n} HP tokens on it
Add the Sidhar, Kirima and Elspeth hero cards and figures to the heroes to choose from
Each player picks a hero card (chosen or random) onto their sheet
Hero figures in their stands (stand color matches the card) on the starting tile

details: Magical Affinity: his magic bolt scrolls are not used up (when cursed he discards them like anyone)
Astral Walking: moves through walls, over discovered tiles only
Double Attack: may reroll a combat once and must keep the second roll
Reincarnation: at 0 HP he does not fall unconscious; he teleports to any healing fountain tile and heals fully, but his turn ends
Sacrifice: once per combat, after rolling, may pay 1 HP for +1 strength (paying his last HP knocks him out for his next turn)
Magic Swap: for all 4 moves (start of turn), swaps places with any other hero; may still use the ability of the tile he ends on
Backstab: wins any combat that would be a tie
Stealth: may enter a monster's tile and walk on without fighting it
Combat Training: rerolls any die that shows 1, as often as needed
Unstoppable: if a die shows 6 in combat, he may keep moving afterwards, even after a tie or a loss
Farseeing: +1 to her roll when she fights on the first move of her turn
Fateweaver: draws 2 tokens from the bag, places 1 and returns the other
Berserk: +1 attack at exactly 3 or 4 HP, +2 at 1 or 2 HP; when healing he chooses how many HP to heal
Perseverance: after defeating a monster without taking its loot, he may use his remaining moves
Sword Master: a sword has strength 3 in his hands
Blitz Attack: for all 4 moves, teleports to any tile with a monster and fights it; if he loses he picks where to retreat (discovered tiles only)
Throwing Daggers: may put daggers (strength 1) in her spell slots; each adds +1 in combat and is not used up
Sprint: instead of a normal move, may sprint up to 8 tiles, over discovered tiles only
Bear Attack: a 1 on a combat die counts as a 6
Eavesdropping: for 1 move, explores an adjacent tile (draws its token) without entering it; she may repeat it
Skin of Steel: loses HP from a lost battle only if he lost it by 3 or more
Transformation: may set a drawn token aside and draw again, 1 HP each time; the set-aside tokens go back in the bag
Dual Wielding: may reroll one die in each combat and must keep the new roll
Tactical Reposition: for 1 move and 1 HP, passes through a monster's tile to the tile beyond
Protector: as a move, jumps to any tile with a hurt hero and heals them 1 HP (an unconscious hero wakes up)
Ambush: +1 strength against a monster revealed on an earlier turn

steps.text: Game ends when someone defeats the dragon and loots its treasure; most treasure wins
Lord of Karak version: he enters play once 5 of his chambers are discovered, controlled by the player with the weakest hero
Roll the dice to determine the starting player
